title: Revise Heating Intro Animations
summary: Rebuilt Heating/1_introduction around one shared warm|wall|cold section that every beat redraws, so conduction, convection and radiation are finally seen crossing the same temperature difference instead of in three unrelated cartoons. Heat is drawn as a wave and occupants as body glyphs, removing Beat 1's central ambiguity; the travel-agency and bouncer metaphors in beats 6-9 were replaced by temperature gradients, real layer build-ups and responsive gauges. Promoted the layout-zone and gauge helpers from Cooling/6 into manim_visuals.py as one source and re-verified scene_6. 9/9 beats render clean over three passes with frame readback.
